title: Audit Sampling and Vouching from Invoices
summary: Select samples from the ledger, pull invoices, GRNs and payment proofs, and check each voucher against the entry, with every exception sent to the audit senior.

seo.title: AI Audit Sampling and Vouching | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that selects audit samples, reads invoices, GRNs and bank advices, tests attributes against the ledger and builds a vouching sheet for review.

problem.intro: In statutory, tax and internal audits, teams pick samples from the purchase, sales and expense ledgers and vouch each entry against invoices, GRNs, purchase orders and bank payments. The client sends documents in batches over email and WhatsApp, and the working paper that records what was checked is often assembled at the end from memory.

pain_points.title: Vouching consumes junior time
pain_points.detail: Articled assistants open every PDF to check party, GSTIN, date, amount and approval, and type the result into a sheet, entry after entry.

pain_points.title: Sample selection is hard to defend
pain_points.detail: Haphazard picks and undocumented criteria make it difficult to show a reviewer how the sample was drawn or to re-perform it.

pain_points.title: Supporting documents arrive incomplete
pain_points.detail: Missing GRNs, unsigned invoices and bills in another entity's name are tracked in a side spreadsheet that falls out of date.

pain_points.title: Thin working papers
pain_points.detail: Reviewers see ticks without the evidence behind them, which leads to review points and rework late in the engagement.

solution.overview: We build a vouching assistant that takes the ledger export from Tally, SAP or Zoho Books, checks the population against the trial balance and helps the engagement team pick samples by a documented method: monetary unit, stratified, random with a recorded seed, or key items above a threshold. For each sampled entry it reads the invoice, purchase order, GRN and bank debit, extracts the attributes your audit programme requires and compares them with the ledger. Matches, mismatches and missing documents land in a vouching sheet with links to the source page, and the audit senior clears or escalates each exception.
capabilities: Sample selection by monetary unit, stratified, random-with-seed or key-item rules, with parameters recorded
Reads tax invoices, purchase orders, GRNs, delivery challans and bank advices, including phone photos
Attribute tests per audit programme: party, GSTIN, invoice date against booking period, amounts, tax rate, approval
Cut-off checks for entries booked around the period end
Pending-document list generated for each client contact
Vouching sheet export in the firm's working paper format with source-page links

workflow.title: Import the ledger and set the population
workflow.detail: The ledger export is loaded and its totals are agreed to the trial balance before anything is sampled.

workflow.title: Select samples
workflow.detail: The senior chooses the method and parameters; the tool draws the sample and records the seed and criteria.

workflow.title: Collect supporting documents
workflow.detail: Client uploads are mapped to sampled entries, and a pending list goes back to the client for anything missing.

workflow.title: Extract and compare attributes
workflow.detail: OCR and an LLM read each document and compare the required attributes with the ledger entry.

workflow.title: Review exceptions
workflow.detail: Mismatches and low-confidence attributes go to the audit senior, who clears, escalates or requests more evidence.

workflow.title: Produce the working paper
workflow.detail: The vouching sheet, selection log and reviewer actions are exported to the engagement file.

inputs: General ledger or purchase register export
Tax invoices, debit notes and credit notes
Purchase orders, GRNs and delivery challans
outputs: Sample selection log with method, parameters and seed
Vouching sheet with attribute results and source links
human_in_the_loop: The audit senior approves the sampling method and parameters before selection and clears every exception. The engagement manager reviews the working paper; the tool records evidence and never forms the audit conclusion.
integrations: Tally Prime, SAP or Zoho Books exports (Excel, XML or API)
Audit working paper software or the firm's Excel templates
Google Drive or SharePoint client folders
Email and WhatsApp Business API for document requests
guardrails: Population totals agreed to the trial balance before sampling
Selection parameters and seed logged so the sample can be re-performed
No exception is cleared without a named reviewer
Every attribute linked to its source page
Client data segregated by engagement with role-based access
compliance_notes: Designed to help engagement teams document sampling and evidence in line with ICAI Standards on Auditing such as SA 230, SA 500 and SA 530.
The engagement team remains responsible for evaluating evidence and forming the audit opinion.

pilot.scope: One audit area, such as purchases and expenses, for one or two completed prior-year engagements, compared with the vouching your team already performed.
deliverables: Attribute schema mapped to your audit programme
Vouching sheet in your working paper format
Comparison report against the manual vouching

what_we_measure.how: Compared with the values recorded in the team's manual vouching sheet for the same entries.
Share of tool-raised exceptions the audit senior confirms as genuine.
Timed on a sample of entries vouched with and without the tool.
Compared with the PBC follow-ups the team actually raised on those engagements.

faqs.q: Does the tool decide sample sizes?
faqs.a: No. Your engagement team sets materiality, risk assessment and sample size under your firm's methodology. The tool applies the selection method you choose and records the parameters and seed so the selection can be re-performed.

faqs.q: Can we put the output straight into our working papers?
faqs.a: The vouching sheet exports in your working paper format with links to each source page. The senior's review and sign-off are recorded on it, and retention follows your firm's documentation policy.

faqs.q: What about poor scans and invoices in Hindi or regional languages?
faqs.a: Phone photos, skewed scans and bilingual invoices are handled, and any attribute the system is unsure about goes to review rather than being marked as matched. The pilot reports accuracy separately for clean and poor-quality documents.
In your cloud account or an India region, segregated by client and engagement, with access limited to the engagement team. Data is deleted at the end of the retention period your firm sets.
